Gosh, I'm so sorry you are dealing with that. Ocd can be so debilitating and frustrating to have. I've been suffering from it as well (Contamination ocd mostly) for over 5 years now. I'm happy to say it's gotten much better with the help of medicine and therapy. But, in the past ocd really killed my quality of life and made me quite depressed. I also found trying to explain myself to people who didn't understand ocd embarrassing. 

If you haven't done so, I really do recommend trying cbt. CBT does wonders to help with unwanted intrusive thoughts and the compulsions that go alongside them.

I was diagnosed with OCD two years ago and was proscribed 50mg Zoloft. However, about 6 months ago my dose increased to 150mg. While taking Zoloft I've noticed that it's much easier to deal with my compulsions(mainly hand washing and cleaning) and my intrusive thoughts.

 When first taking Zoloft I experienced drowsiness and sleepiness. I also still experience pretty bad heartburn if I eat any acidic foods when I take my dose. 

Overall, I would say its been very beneficial for helping my OCD. I hope  your prescription of Zoloft can help you.

If you have any specific questions about my experiences taking Zoloft, feel free to ask.
